days.title: North and Cultural Circuit
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Cascina Centro Parco
stops.detail: The entity that manages the area has its legal headquarters in this last municipality, in the Cascina Centro Parco, which is however accessed from Bresso.

stops.name: villa di Alessandro Manzoni
stops.detail: Inside the park there is a complex of upper secondary schools: the Casiraghi scientific, linguistic and classical high school (Cinisello Balsamo), the ITIS Cartesio (Industrial Technical Institute) and the IIS Eugenio Montale (Cinisello Balsamo); Alessandro Manzoni's villa in Brusuglio, the Bassini Hospital (Cinisello Balsamo) and an airport for tourist-civil use (Bresso).

days.title: Hill and Sport Exploration
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: montagnetta
stops.detail: It is flat for most of its surface; however, in the area on the border between Sesto San Giovanni and Bresso, south of the pedestrian and cycle bridge on via Gian Carlo Clerici, stands the so-called little mountain, formed in the last century by steel mill processing residues and subsequently reclaimed.

stops.name: teatrino
stops.detail: On the little mountain there is a concrete and wooden structure, called the "little theater" and used for various events.

stops.name: velodromo
stops.detail: In the area east of the Foglia pedestrian and cycle bridge on via XX Settembre, in Bresso, an outdoor bicycle speed ring (velodrome) was built.
